title: Microbial DNA extraction from the brown seaweed Ascophyllum nodosum
author: Coralie Rousseau
materials: In sterile condition, grind sample by hand with sterile mortar and pestle until a very fine powder is obtained Clean with ethanol 70% mortar and pestle to avoid contaminations between samples Take 10 mg of ground algal tissue, put into 2 mL Eppendorf tube with 1 steel bead Put in Qiagen TissueLyser II bead beater ( 00:01:00 , 30 Hz)
DNA must be measured by Qubit Fluorometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) or equivalent

steps.title: Remove Acetone from Sample
steps.instruction: Remove acetone from the sample through repeated washing and centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL acetone (100%).
Vortex and centrifuge at 12800 x g for 1 minute at 21 °C.
Remove acetone by pipetting.
Repeat these steps.
Dry for 5 to 10 minutes at room temperature to remove remaining acetone.

steps.title: Prepare CTAB Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 23 mL of CTAB buffer in a 50 mL Falcon tube using the following components:

substeps.instruction: Add 4.6 mL of 10% CTAB (final concentration 2%).
Add 0.46 g of PVPP (final concentration 2%).
Add 2.3 mL of 1000 Tris-HCl pH 8 (final concentration 100).
Add 6.44 mL of 5M NaCl (final concentration 1.4).
Add 0.92 mL of 500 EDTA pH 8 (final concentration 20).
Add 8.74 mL of sterile H2O.
Mix the preparation.
Keep buffer at 21 °C or higher to prevent precipitation; use fresh buffer for each extraction.

steps.title: Remove Beads
steps.instruction: Remove the bead from each tube by reversing the tube to make it roll away.

steps.title: Initial DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract DNA using CTAB buffer and chloroform/isoamyl.

substeps.instruction: In 2 mL Eppendorf Safe-Lock Tubes, add 1 mL of CTAB buffer to each sample.
Add 35 µL of 0.1M DIECA (Sodium Diethyldithiocarbamate) and 10 µL of β-mercaptoethanol.
Incubate for 1 hour at 65 °C.
Under a Sorbonne, add 1 mL of chloroform/isoamyl (24:1, v/v).
Seal tubes with parafilm to avoid chloroform vapors.
Vortex and centrifuge at 13200 rpm for 30 minutes at 21 °C.
Collect 750 µL of the upper phase in a new 2 mL Eppendorf Safe-Lock Tube, avoiding the interphase.

steps.title: Secondary DNA Purification
steps.instruction: Further purify the upper phase using ethanol and chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Add 225 µL of 100% ethanol drop by drop to the upper phase and mix by pipette agitation.
Add 975 µL of 100% chloroform.
Seal tubes with parafilm to avoid chloroform vapors.
Vortex and centrifuge at 13200 rpm for 20 minutes at 21 °C.
Collect 550 µL of the upper phase in new 2 mL Eppendorf Safe-Lock Tubes, avoiding the interphase.

steps.title: Precipitate and Wash DNA
steps.instruction: Precipitate the DNA and perform initial pellet washes.

substeps.instruction: Add 110 µL of 3M sodium acetate to the upper phase.
Add 1.1 mL of 100% ethanol and mix by tube inversion to precipitate DNA.
Incubate at -80 °C for 1 hour.
Prepare 50 mL of 70% ethanol and keep on ice.
Centrifuge at 13200 rpm for 30 minutes at 4 °C.
Carefully remove the liquid phase without disturbing the DNA pellet.

steps.title: Wash and Dry DNA Pellet
steps.instruction: Perform final washes and dry the DNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 µL of cold 70% ethanol.
Vortex and centrifuge at 13200 rpm for 10 minutes at 4 °C.
Carefully remove the liquid phase without disturbing the pellet.
Repeat this wash step once.
Spin down to collect remaining ethanol and remove the upper phase by pipetting.
Dry the pellet for 5 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in biological grade water.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL of biological grade water and mix by pipetting 10 times.
Optional: Store at -20 °C.
Add 400 µL of biological grade water to the extracted DNA and mix by pipetting 10 times.
Add 400 µL to a purple NucleoSpin column; centrifuge at 11000 x g for 2 minutes at 21 °C.
Keep the flow-through (containing the DNA).
Add 450 µL of Buffer PC to the flow-through and mix by pipetting 5 times.
Add 450 µL to a green NucleoSpin column; centrifuge at 11000 x g for 1 minute at 21 °C and discard flow-through.
Add the remaining volume to the green NucleoSpin column; centrifuge at 11000 x g for 1 minute at 21 °C and discard flow-through.
Add 400 µL of buffer PW1 to the green column; centrifuge at 11000 x g for 1 minute at 21 °C and discard flow-through.
Add 700 µL of buffer PW2 to the green column; centrifuge at 11000 x g for 1 minute at 21 °C and discard flow-through.
Repeat the PW2 wash step.
Add 200 µL of buffer PW2 to the green column; centrifuge at 11000 x g for 1 minute at 21 °C and discard flow-through.

steps.title: Elute DNA from Column
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the green NucleoSpin column.

substeps.instruction: Place the green column in a clean 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Add 25 µL of Buffer PE to the membrane.
Incubate at 65 °C for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge at 11000 x g for 1 minute at 21 °C.
Keep the flow-through (containing the DNA).
Repeat the elution process.
Optional: Store at -20 °C.

steps.title: AMPure XP Bead Cleanup
steps.instruction: Perform magnetic bead cleanup in sterile conditions.

substeps.instruction: Bring Agencourt AMPure XP to room temperature for 30 minutes and shake to resuspend particles.
Prepare fresh 70% ethanol with biological grade water.
Add 90 µL of Agencourt AMPure XP (calculated as 1.8 x sample volume) and mix by pipetting 10 times until homogenous.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place the Eppendorf tube on a DynaMag-2 magnet for 2 minutes until the solution clears.
Slowly remove and discard the upper phase, leaving a few µL of supernatant to avoid losing beads.
Add 200 µL of 70% ethanol and incubate for 30 seconds at room temperature.
Slowly remove and discard the supernatant by pipetting.
Repeat the ethanol wash step.

steps.title: Final Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the DNA from the magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Remove the tube from the magnet and dry the pellet until it is slightly cracked.
Add 50 µL of NucleoSpin elution buffer PE and mix by pipetting 10 times.
Incubate for 2 minutes at room temperature.
Place the tube on the DynaMag-2 magnet for 1 minute.
Transfer the DNA elution (upper phase) into a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Storage and Final Processing
steps.instruction: Store the DNA or perform final drying.

substeps.instruction: For short-reads: Store at -20 °C.
For long-reads: Store at -80 °C.
If required, place Buffer PE at 65 °C and dry matter in a freeze-dryer for at least 48 hours.
